offering_description.value: Provides clinical laboratory testing, drug development services and diagnostic information to healthcare providers, pharmaceutical companies, and patients. Runs a large network of patient service sites and laboratories, and bills payers, providers, and patients for testing.

primary_products.value: diagnostic lab tests; diagnostic imaging services; drug testing kits; genetic testing; medical devices and reagents

primary_services.value: clinical laboratory testing; contract clinical research; central laboratory services; drug development support; patient specimen collection

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, physician practices, health systems, pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors, employers; B2C: individual patients ordering consumer-directed lab tests; B2G: government health programs and public agencies

end_markets.value: healthcare; life sciences; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; insurance

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from insurers and government programs for lab testing; service fees: fees for clinical trial and drug development services; product sales: diagnostic kits, reagents and devices sold to labs and providers; project or contract: multi-year contracts with pharmaceutical sponsors for trial services
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs testing and trial services, selling to providers, insurers and sponsors; asset operator: operates laboratory and patient service site networks; OEM / manufacturer: makes some diagnostic reagents and kits sold to other labs
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: United States and many countries across Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: diversified: diagnostics laboratory services, clinical trial and drug development services, and related patient testing lines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to hospitals, pharma sponsors and health systems; own locations: patient service centers and laboratory sites; partners / resellers: health system and hospital outreach lab partnerships; online: consumer-directed test ordering through websites
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: CLIA-certified laboratory testing, FDA rules for diagnostics and trials, and HIPAA privacy rules

notes: Business mix and geographic breadth are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
